messages:
deploy-bot: Canary alert: deployment redwood/api@v3.2.0 shows p95 latency +30% over baseline and error_rate 0.8% (> alert threshold). Auto-rollback suggested. [actions: :rollback, :hold]
katie: Noted. We're in a scheduled DB migration change window starting in ~12m. If we rollback now we might conflict with migration. Thoughts? @sre-oncall
sre-oncall: Migration is in preflight but close to starting. Pausing migration is possible but adds risk. If we rollback mid-migration we could create schema mismatches. Propose partial traffic rollback (reduce to 10%) first.
aj: Could we pin dedicated customers to v3.1.9 while the hosted API goes back? That would avoid impacting enterprise tenants. It requires a small config change but I can do it if we act fast.
leo: Deploy-bot, what's the exact auto-rollback policy? I recall we only auto-rollback on error_rate>=1.0 historically.
deploy-bot: Current policy: auto-trigger if error_rate >= 0.7 AND p95 increase >= 25% over baseline for 5 consecutive minutes. Conditions met for 6m. Action queued: auto-rollback in 3m unless manual override received.
emma: I'm scheduled for rotation handoff in ~8m. I can stay and take the rollback if needed, and manage comms. @katie can you approve me taking the manual override?
katie: Approve. Emma you run the rollback. Aj, please implement the dedicated-customer pin. Leo, please confirm with the DB migration owner that rollback won't block anything critical.
aj: Starting pin now. ETA ~9m.
leo: Pinged @db-migration-owner — they responded: migration not yet schema-impacting, should be safe if rollback happens now, but they ask for a short validation after rollback completes.
emma: Plan: perform a graceful rollback + traffic switch and run validation checks. Commands I'll run (runbook excerpt):
```bash
# rollback service to stable
redwood rollback --service api --to v3.1.9 --reason "canary p95 regression"
# ensure traffic fully on v3.1.9
redwood traffic update --service api --split 100:0
# perform smoke checks
scripts/smoke_check_api.sh || true
```
I will also add an entry to release notes & send an internal comms blurb to #incidents and product.
deploy-bot: Action log: queued -> manual_override by emma. Auto-rollback cancelled.
emma: Executing rollback now. Will post brief updates every 2m.
emma: Rollback finished. Traffic now at 100% v3.1.9. p95 returned to baseline within 3m. Smoke checks pass.
aj: Dedicated pin completed. Notified account team and ops.
leo: DB owner validated post-rollback state. No migration conflicts.
katie: Thanks team. Emma, could you please draft the short release note: what rolled back, why (canary p95 +30% / error_rate 0.8), who acted, and customer impact (none for pinned customers)? Add it to the 1-line changelog and flag for the weekly release notes.
emma: Will do and assign postmortem to @leo and @emma for deeper analysis. Closing thread.
_meta: generated for dataset - slack thread representing rollback coordination, manual override during change window, rotation handoff, dedicated pin and comms
